thread:
Maya R: Pager hit — high error-rate on hosted inference for model-redwood-xl in us-west-2, P1. Incident-bot posted details. tagging primary/secondary: @Amy (primary), @Liam (secondary). please ack and start quick triage.
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - inference.error_rate > 5% for 5m on model-redwood-xl (us-west-2). Ticket: INC-2026-4873. Links: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-4873, runbook: https://runbooks.internal/kv-cache-stall (read-only).
Amy (SRE): Acked. I’m primary for the next 45m — will take bridge. Initial check: rolling errors look like kvcache misses and some 504s from runtime. Marking customer impact: noisy for free-tier traffic and some authenticated enterprise requests hitting fallback.
Liam: On secondary, I can take over if you need to step out. Quick question — any recent rollouts to redwood-xl?
Jorge C: Not that I see in release dashboard for last 2h. No canary rollouts. Autoscaler did a small scale-up 12m ago (routine).
Amy (SRE): Running quick checks now. First steps: 1) confirm kvcache hit ratio, 2) check runtime queues, 3) consider temporary fallback to redwood-xl-quantized if latency acceptable.
Amy (SRE): Command snippets:
```bash
# check kvcache metrics
curl -s "https://prometheus.internal/api/v1/query?query=kvcache_hit_ratio{region=\"us-west-2\",model=\"redwood-xl\"}"
# check runtime pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime-usw2 -o wide
# tail runtime logs for errors
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/runtime-usw2 -c runtime --since=10m | grep -i error
```
Maya R: Add to that: perms to restart the runtime instances are limited — ping infra channel if you need force restarts. Also note: we have fallback routing policy: route 30% to redwood-xl-quantized during incidents.
incident-bot: Update: 3ppl paged, 2 acknowledgements. Current severity: P1.
Amy (SRE): Observations: kvcache miss rate spiked ~6m ago, p99 latency rose to 2.3s, error-rate ~7%. Taking immediate mitigations: enabling prefix caching for the most common prompt-hashes and toggling batching down to force smaller batches (temp).
Liam: I can flip the fallback routing for you if you want me to — have the permission set. Ready on my mark.
Amy (SRE): Please do a controlled switch: route 25% to quantized variant, monitor error-rate for 5m. Liam ping when done.
Liam: Done — routed 25% to redwood-xl-quantized just now. Command used: `rdwctl routing set --model redwood-xl --variant quantized --percent 25 --region us-west-2`.
Amy (SRE): Monitoring... error-rate dropped to ~3.1% within 2 min, p99 down to 1.1s. Good short-term relief. Leaving note to pursue root cause — likely kvcache eviction pattern or kernel/quantization fallback code path.
Maya R: Customer impact quick list (from GA and ent logs): 1) Free tier chat sessions degraded (high latency + errors) 2) Two mid-size customers reported failures (ticketed) 3) Internal CI jobs saw timeouts. Please add affected customer IDs to the incident ticket.
Jorge C: Put in an automated note to INC-2026-4873 with the customer IDs and approximate time window (4801234500-4801234670).
Amy (SRE): Next remediation steps (runbook quick pointers): - check kvcache memory pressure on pods (`kubectl top pod`), - bump runtime pool for us-west-2 by +2 GPUs for 10m if error-rate stays >4%, - if kvcache eviction high, roll kvcache config to increase ttl for hot keys: https://config.redwood/kvcache/hotkeys.
Amy (SRE): If mitigation fails after 15m escalate to infra lead @Jorge C and open a capacity request: https://infra-ops/requests/new (include logs and prom queries).
Maya R: On-call handoff note for whoever picks next primary: timestamp this thread as handoff anchor, include the following in your summary: what we toggled, fallback %, metrics at handoff, and next steps.
Liam: Quick advisory to product: temporary quality delta expected for quantized variant — doc: https://docs.redwood/models/quantized-variants#tradeoffs. Posting to #product-alerts.
Amy (SRE): I'm going to stay primary until we reach stable error-rate <1% for 10m and then handback. I'll post a final handback message.
Oncall Bot: Reminder scheduled: if no stable state by +30m, auto-escalation to infra lead.
Amy (SRE): Final update before handback: error-rate steady at 0.8% for 12m, p99 ~0.9s, quantized route at 20% now. I'm stepping down in 5m, handing to @Liam. Notes added to INC-2026-4873 with commands run and key logs.
Liam: Taking primary. All notes clear. I’ll keep an eye for 30m and will unwind routing to 0% only after 20m stable.
Maya R: Thanks team — good coordination. For the runbook index pin these quick links in the incident ticket: https://runbooks.internal/kv-cache-stall, https://runbooks.internal/fallback-routing, https://runbooks.internal/scale-runtime.
Amy (SRE): handback complete. leaving final short checklist: what we changed, why, who to ping if reoccurs (Jorge infra), and follow-up action to run longer kvcache retention experiment in staging. :white_check_mark:
Liam: Acknowledged. closing bridge, keeping watch. :thumbsup:
